blurb: Join the local operator on a four-hour tour through Denver and into the beautiful front range mountains of the Rockies. Experience the famous Red Rocks Amphitheater, spectacular vistas and historic neighboring areas. This tour is a great introduction to Denver Metro, Golden and the mountains we're known for.
